forSalons.title: Let clients try your designs before they book.
forSalons.body: A branded try-on page on your own address, a booking engine with WhatsApp confirmations, and a calendar your team actually uses. Live in about 15 minutes.
forSalons.p1: Clients open yoursalon.nailswap.app, try your designs on their own hands with live AR or an AI photo, and book the exact look.
forSalons.p2: Real-time availability per technician, confirmations and reminders on WhatsApp, fewer no-shows.
forSalons.p3: See which designs get tried, booked and rebooked. Share images and QR cards straight from the dashboard.
